basic_info.description: Enjoy neighborhood charm and original architectural details--coved ceilings, wainscoting, picture rails, built-ins, and a brick fireplace--paired seamlessly with modern comforts in this gem of a single family home with a sunny garden and garage just a block from Precita Park. Recent upgrades include refinished hardwood floors throughout, fresh exterior paint and updated windows. The spacious eat-in kitchen features updated stainless appliances: newer refrigerator, dishwasher, gas stove, and refreshed flooring. Two bedrooms invite everyday comfort and natural light, while the updated full bathroom features new tile floors. Lower level provides laundry with upgraded LG washer/dryer, utility sink, and extra storage. Ideal location near Precita Park, Cortland Ave shops, Mission Street dining, easy freeway access (101/80/280), and 24th/Mission BART. Parks, cafes, dining, and shops are all just moments away. This rare offering in North Slope Bernal unlocks a sought-after lifestyle.
